note: Case SHELLS only (BUILD-DISTRICT-ENGLISH §2): 30 slots across the two tracks, GL first as instructed. Titles, narratives, Mode assets, Walk scripts, passages and items are all reviewer-pipeline content and are deliberately absent — every slot below is an empty room with a name on the door. The two tracks are two subjects (§1): a child runs one, with the other reachable, and no slot belongs to both.
